items.headline: PTC surges after Schneider Electric announces $22.6 billion bid
items.summary: Reuters reported that PTC was a major premarket mover after Schneider Electric agreed to acquire it for $22.6 billion.

items.headline: Cerebras gains after Sam Altman calls company a close partner
items.summary: Reuters reported that Cerebras shares rose after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman described the company as a close partner.

items.headline: Nvidia edges higher as technology stocks remain near record levels
items.summary: Reuters reported that Nvidia edged up in premarket trading while technology stocks paused after reaching record highs.

items.headline: Intel falls as chip stocks weigh on premarket trading
items.summary: Reuters reported that Intel declined 3.8% in premarket trading, contributing to weakness among chip stocks.

items.headline: Micron dips as semiconductor stocks take a breather
items.summary: Reuters reported that Micron declined 0.6% in premarket trading as technology stocks eased from recent highs.

items.headline: Nasdaq advances as technology and AI-linked shares lead gains
items.summary: ROIC News reported that the Nasdaq rose as megacap technology and AI-exposed companies benefited from reduced expectations of an imminent Federal Reserve rate increase.
